profile.summary: Genie generates new protein backbones with a diffusion model. It represents a structure as a cloud of oriented residues: noise is added to and removed from the alpha carbon coordinates, while the network reasons over Frenet-Serret frames built from the backbone geometry, which give each residue a position and an orientation. Sampling runs the reverse diffusion for 1,000 steps and writes alpha carbon coordinates, with no sequence input. The published models were trained from scratch on filtered SCOPe domains or on AlphaFold predictions of SwissProt, and the authors report designability, diversity and novelty against RFdiffusion, FrameDiff and other generators. The model is small, 4.1 million parameters against RFdiffusion's 59.8 million.

sections.title: How it works
sections.body: The forward process adds Gaussian noise to the alpha carbon coordinates of a domain over a fixed variance schedule with 1,000 steps. The network is trained to predict the noise added at each step, following the usual denoising diffusion objective, so training reduces to fitting that noise prediction model. What makes the representation asymmetric is that the input is a point cloud while the reasoning is frame based: Frenet-Serret frames are constructed from the backbone geometry of the noised structure, giving each residue an orientation as well as a position, which the authors call equivariantly diffusing oriented residue clouds. The architecture uses pair transform layers, with triangular attention switched off in the shipped configuration. At sampling time the noise vector can be multiplied by a constant factor, in the manner of low temperature sampling, which trades designability against diversity.

sections.title: Versions and reproducibility
sections.body: The weights ship inside the repository rather than on a model hub. At the commit read here there are three sets, each with its own configuration file: weights/scope_l_128 with epoch=49999.ckpt, weights/scope_l_256 with epoch=29999.ckpt, and weights/swissprot_l_256 with epoch=99.ckpt. The names match the paper's variants: a model trained on SCOPe with a maximum length of 128, and the two long models, Genie-SCOPe and Genie-SwissProt, both with the maximum sequence length set to 256. The shipped configuration for scope_l_256 sets maximumNumResidues to 256, five pair transform layers, no triangular attention and a learning rate of 1e-4. A result should name the weight folder, the checkpoint epoch, the repository commit and the sampling noise scale, since that scale changes the output distribution.

facts.label: Training data
facts.value: Two datasets. SCOPe domains, filtered so that no two share more than 40 per cent sequence identity and with multi-chain or incomplete domains removed, giving 8,766 domains of which 3,942 have at most 128 residues and 7,249 at most 256. And AlphaFold predictions of SwissProt, filtered at an average pLDDT above 80, leaving 195,214 structures of at most 256 residues.

run_guide.summary: Install the package from the repository and sample domains with one of the shipped checkpoints.
prerequisites: A GPU, since the sampling command selects one by index.
The SCOPe dataset only for training, through the repository's download script.
For designability scoring, the extra setup script that installs ProteinMPNN and ESMFold.
Apache-2.0 terms for the code and the committed weights.

notes: The record came from the Scaffold-Lab benchmark (existing source lit-structure-20261011-scaffoldlab-source-zheng2026) and dates Genie to 2023-01, which matches the first arXiv posting. One inconsistency in the developers' own text: the README loads 'weights/configuration' and 'weights/genie_l_128_epoch=49999.ckpt', neither of which exists at the commit read; the repository holds per-model folders scope_l_128, scope_l_256 and swissprot_l_256, each with a configuration file and one checkpoint. The 4.1M parameter figure is given once in the paper for the architecture and is applied here to all three checkpoints, which the paper says share the architecture. A later Genie 2 was not searched for. The sampling range of 50 to 128 residues is the default of genie/sample.py and is not tied to a checkpoint in the README.
